title: Universal Life Insurance Compliance Computation Sheet: Guideline Excess
content:
Computation of the premium above the guideline premium limit on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, and of the refund that returns it.

## Statement

1. **Net premiums.** The gross premiums received in the activity history (the gross amounts of every premium received entry), less the premiums already refunded (every premium refund entry), less the amounts of the partial withdrawals (every partial withdrawal entry).
2. **Guideline premium limit.** The greater of the policy's guideline single premium and the policy's guideline level premium times the policy years begun to date, both premiums as shown on the policy record. The policy years begun to date are the number of the current policy year: 1 in the first policy year, 12 in the twelfth.
3. **Guideline excess.** The net premiums above the guideline premium limit, and nothing when they do not exceed it.
4. **Excess payment.** The excess is treated as carried in by the most recent premium payment in the activity history; its receipt date is that entry's date.
5. **Refund.** The guideline excess refund is the guideline excess, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs at a glance

| Figure | Read from |
|---|---|
| Gross premiums received | Premium received entries, gross amounts |
| Premiums already refunded | Premium refund entries |
| Partial withdrawals | Partial withdrawal entries |
| Guideline single premium, guideline level premium | Policy record |
| Policy year | Issue date to the date of figuring |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Item | Policy in year 12 | Policy in year 9 |
|---|---|---|
| Gross premiums received | $152000.00 | $98000.00 |
| Less premiums refunded | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Less partial withdrawals | $2000.00 | $0.00 |
| Net premiums | $150000.00 | $98000.00 |
| Guideline single premium | $120000.00 | $120000.00 |
| Guideline level premium times years begun | $11000.00 times 12, $132000.00 | $11000.00 times 9, $99000.00 |
| Guideline premium limit (the greater) | $132000.00 | $120000.00 |
| Guideline excess | $18000.00 | nothing |
| Refund | $18000.00 | none |

Equality is not excess: net premiums exactly equal to the limit leave a guideline excess of nothing.
